About the Role

The Strategic Project Lead – Multimodal AI supports frontier AI development through complex, high-quality data programs for leading AI companies. We’re looking for someone with experience in multimodal AI data, such as image, video, 3D, sensor, or robotics-related workflows. 

You’ll lead projects that turn complex real-world data into reliable training and evaluation resources. Combining project management with hands-on domain knowledge, you’ll partner with clients and internal teams to design workflows, maintain quality, and solve challenging data delivery problems in a rapidly evolving AI market. 

Your Impact

• Own end-to-end project delivery across scope, timelines, budgets, staffing, and risks.  

• Lead client communication, status reporting, planning sessions, and escalations. 

• Translate technical and client requirements into data collection workflows, annotation guidelines, tooling, and quality standards. 

• Define quality metrics and acceptance criteria for multimodal data and annotation outputs. 

• Monitor delivery quality, troubleshoot data issues, and resolve ambiguous requirements with clients. 

• Advise on project feasibility, collection methods, annotation approaches, and tooling based on your domain expertise. 

• Build reusable SOPs, guidelines, and QA frameworks to support consistent delivery. 

• Mentor Operations Specialists and contribute to project scoping, pilots, and emerging multimodal AI capabilities. 

What You Bring

• 1–2+ years of experience in AI data operations, project coordination, or delivery, ideally in a GenAI or frontier AI environment.

• Familiarity with at least one multimodal data workflow involving images, video, 3D data, sensors, or robotics. 

• Experience coordinating projects or workstreams, managing stakeholders, and communicating with clients. 

• Understanding of data quality, annotation workflows, and quality assurance methods.

• Ability to translate project requirements into clear data collection workflows, annotation guidelines, and quality standards. 

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment. 

• Interest in current AI developments, including multimodal models, spatial AI, or embodied AI. 

Nice to Have

• Experience with image or video annotation, 3D data, point clouds, or sensor data. 

• Familiarity with robotics data collection or real-world perception workflows. 

• Exposure to 2D or 3D labeling, segmentation, tracking, or structured annotation tasks. 

• Experience with autonomous systems, spatial AI, or embodied AI. 

• Bilingual capabilities, particularly German or a Nordic language. 

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Appen, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We value curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to delivering the highest quality AI solutions for frontier models.

You'll work on complex challenges that shape the future of AI across industries and geographies, alongside talented people in a culture that values humility over ego. You'll have the flexibility to deliver in a way that works for you and your team, supported by tools, resources, and development opportunities to continue to build your capability over time.

About Appen

Appen has been a leader in AI training data for over 30 years. We specialise in human generated data to train, fine tune, and evaluate models across generative AI, large language models, computer vision, and speech recognition. Our AI assisted data annotation platform and global crowd of more than 1 million contributors in over 200 countries support model pre training, supervised fine tuning, evaluation and benchmarking, safety and red teaming, and multilingual global expansion.

Role Description

ML Engineer I AI / ML Engineer | Generative AI, Agentic AI & Enterprise ML Who We Are Born digital, UST transforms lives through the power of technology. Our 29,000+ practical problem solvers and creative thinkers work across more than 30 countries, helping clients build human-centered solutions and lasting business impact. Our teams combine innovation, agility, and engineering excellence across healthcare, financial services, insurance, retail, manufacturing, telecommunications, and other industries. You Are You are an AI-first engineer who enjoys turning ambiguous customer challenges into working, production-grade AI systems. You bring strong Machine Learning fundamentals, hands-on Generative AI experience, and the ability to build reliable agents, RAG applications, and cloud-native services. You move quickly, learn new tools deliberately, and take ownership from proof of concept through measurable customer outcomes. The Opportunity Builder Mode

• 0→1 engineering. Turn ambiguous requirements into working AI solutions: define the scope, select the right models and tools, build a usable first version, and iterate with customer feedback.
• Production ownership. Design, develop, deploy, and optimize ML and Generative AI applications using Python, modern ML frameworks, and secure cloud services.
• Agentic systems. Create intelligent agents and multi-agent workflows with tool calling, planning, state management, memory, context engineering, and reliable orchestration.
• RAG from data to answer. Own document ingestion, parsing, chunking, embeddings, vector indexing, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and grounded response generation for enterprise RAG.
• Backend integration. Develop FastAPI or Flask services, REST APIs, and integrations with enterprise data sources, microservices, and event-driven systems.
• AI-first delivery. Use Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar tools to accelerate development, automate repetitive work, and improve the quality of tested, maintainable code. Firefighter Mode
• A customer needs a working AI capability under a tight deadline. You identify the smallest viable solution, build it, and make the tradeoffs explicit.
• An agent is failing, a RAG answer is unsupported, or inference latency spikes. You reproduce the issue, inspect traces and metrics, isolate the cause, and close the loop with a measurable fix.
• A new model or framework promises better performance. You run a focused evaluation against quality, latency, cost, and security requirements before recommending adoption.
• You move into unfamiliar customer environments, collaborate with engineers and stakeholders, and communicate risks, blockers, and outcomes without waiting for perfect requirements. Systems Thinker Mode
• Design reusable agent and RAG architectures that separate orchestration, tools, retrieval, model serving, application services, and enterprise integrations.
• Build evaluation and observability into the system: groundedness, retrieval quality, task success, accuracy, latency, token usage, cost, and failure analysis.
• Develop ML pipelines spanning data preparation, feature engineering, training, validation, inference, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
• Apply fine-tuning and optimization techniques such as PEFT, LoRA, instruction tuning, and domain adaptation when evidence supports them.
• Engineer for scalability, resilience, secure access, data protection, governance, and Responsible AI; turn successful prototypes into maintainable cloud-native services. Minimum Qualifications
• Experience. 3–5 years of hands-on experience in ML, AI, or Generative AI engineering, including substantial project ownership and experience delivering enterprise applications into production.
• Education. A Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI, ML, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field is preferred. A Bachelor’s degree with exceptional relevant experience will also be considered.
• Core engineering. Strong Python skills and practical knowledge of supervised and unsupervised learning, neural networks, deep learning, transformers, NLP, statistical modeling, and model evaluation.
• Applied AI. Hands-on experience with at least one agent framework, production-oriented RAG, backend API development, and one major cloud AI platform. Technical Toolkit We value demonstrated depth and the ability to learn adjacent technologies—not superficial familiarity with every tool listed below.
• Agents & orchestration. LangGraph, LangChain, Google ADK, Anthropic Agent SDK, OpenAI SDK, CrewAI, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel; agent orchestration, tools, memory, context management, observability, and evaluation.
• Retrieval systems. Embeddings, hybrid and semantic search, retrieval optimization, reranking, grounding, hallucination mitigation, and RAG evaluation; Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or similar vector stores.
• Backend & data. Python, FastAPI and/or Flask, REST APIs, microservices, clean architecture, SQL, and enterprise data platforms such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Snowflake.
• ML frameworks. PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, and Hugging Face Transformers; model training, fine-tuning, inference optimization, and NLP or computer vision applications.
• Cloud & AI platforms. AWS (Bedrock, AgentCore, SageMaker), Google Cloud (Gemini Enterprise, Vertex AI), or Microsoft Azure (Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI); cloud-native deployment, monitoring, security, and scalability.
• DevOps & MLOps. Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD tooling, MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker or comparable MLOps platforms; production model lifecycle and observability.
• AI-first engineering. GitHub Copilot, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, or Windsurf; practical use of AI-assisted engineering to improve development velocity, quality, and SDLC automation. Preferred Qualifications
• Experience delivering customer-facing AI solutions in consulting or across multiple business domains, including healthcare, insurance, banking, retail, manufacturing, or financial services.
• Publications in leading AI, ML, NLP, computer vision, or data science journals and conferences; open-source contributions or participation in research communities.
• AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, or AI-platform certifications and experience with enterprise security, governance, or Responsible AI practices.
• Demonstrated ability to evaluate emerging technologies, redesign workflows, and deliver measurable improvements in efficiency, quality, cost, or customer outcomes. What We Look For Strong problem-solving and engineering judgment; curiosity and continuous learning; clear communication and stakeholder management; and the ownership to deliver secure, scalable, production-ready AI solutions. You can balance speed with rigor, collaborate across functions, and explain both what works and what does not.

Skills

Python, Generative AI, FastAPI, Machine Learning

About Sarvam
Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India’s full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India’s leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.

The Role
Samvaad is a conversational AI platform for enterprises, startups, digital natives, and governments. We are hiring hands-on technical owners who can take ambiguous problems through to reliable production systems.

At the heart of Sarvam’s conversational AI platform sits the system that lets our customers build, configure, deploy, and operate voice agents and campaigns - at scale. The platform currently powers millions of voice calls a day that are deeply personalised and understands the users.
We’re looking for a Staff Engineer to own this system end-to-end. The data model. The APIs. The orchestration. The reliability. The performance. The standards we hold ourselves to. This is an IC role with the scope and authority of one - no people management, just the systems and the bar.
What You’ll Own
• 
The end-to-end backend for agent, campaign, and user management - from data modeling through API design to deployment, in Python and FastAPI
• 
Workflow orchestration with Temporal for complex, long-running, stateful operations
• 
Performance and reliability for a multi-tenant SaaS platform operating at sub-second latency SLOs
• 
Observability - logging, metrics, tracing - so the team can debug production confidently and quickly
• 
Integration testing - the test infrastructure that lets us ship fast without breaking customer-facing systems
• 
Close collaboration with the frontend team (Next.js) to deliver an experience worthy of the underlying platform
• 
Setting the design-first and documentation-first engineering culture within your team - RFCs before code, decisions written down, no tribal knowledge
What We’re Looking For
• 
8-12 years building production backend systems, with deep expertise in Python and FastAPI (or Golang)
• 
Must-have experience in building telephony infrastructure, primarily SIP / VoIP
• 
A track record of full-stack ownership - you’ve designed systems end-to-end, made the trade-offs, and operated them in production
• 
Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration at scale, ideally Temporal
• 
Built and operated high-scale distributed systems - multi-tenant, low-latency, resilient under real load
• 
Strong PostgreSQL and Redis fundamentals - schema design, query performance, caching strategy
• 
The judgment to know when to build vs. buy, when to optimize vs. ship, when to abstract vs. inline
Nice to Have
• 
Experience building products on top of LLMs or AI/ML systems
• 
Time at an early- or growth-stage startup - comfort with ambiguity, speed, and ownership

Own prompts, evals, guardrails against unsafe medical claims, and cost and latency. • Event-driven backend on AWS - FastAPI services in Docker, images on ECR, Lambda workers, EventBridge schedules and rules, plus queues and storage as needed, for jobs like weekly posting, review sync and audit runs. • Webhooks and reliability - Receive and verify Meta and Google webhooks, handle retries, idempotency, rate limits, pagination and API version upgrades without breaking clinics. • Observability and security - Logging, alerting and dashboards for every integration; least-privilege IAM; secrets in AWS Secrets Manager or SSM; careful handling of patient and clinic data. • Ship with the team -Work closely with the Head of AI & ML and the growth team, write clear docs for each integration, and keep a short changelog of what broke and why. **Skills** • Language - Python 3, production-grade: typing, async, testing with pytest, Node.js /TypeScript for webhook or tooling work • Framework - FastAPI, Pydantic, async HTTP clients (httpx/aiohttp), Celery or similar task queues • Auth - OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect from memory: auth code + PKCE, scopes, refresh tokens, token security, Google service accounts, domain-wide delegation • Google APIs - At least one shipped: GBP, Search Console or Google Ads, Google Analytics Data API, Places API • Meta APIs - At least one shipped: WhatsApp Cloud API, Instagram Graph API or Marketing API Embedded Signup, Conversions API, coexistence • Platform approvals - Has taken an app through Meta App Review or Google OAuth verification to production, Business Verification, Tech Provider onboarding • AI agents - Has shipped an LLM agent to real users: tool/function calling, structured outputs, multi-turn state, prompt design, Agent frameworks (LangGraph, LlamaIndex or similar), MCP, multi-agent workflows • RAG - Embeddings, chunking, vector search (pgvector, OpenSearch, Pinecone or similar), hybrid search, grounding answers in sources, Rerankers, AWS Bedrock Knowledge Bases • LLM ops - Evals, guardrails, tracing, cost and latency control across OpenAI, Anthropic or Bedrock models, Langfuse or LangSmith, fine-tuning, Indian-language handling • Containers - Docker, multi-stage builds, docker-compose for local dev, Container image Lambdas • AWS - Lambda, EventBridge, ECR, IAM, CloudWatch, SQS, ECS/Fargate, API Gateway, Secrets Manager, RDS/DynamoDB • Data - PostgreSQL, schema design, migrations, Redis, DynamoDB • Engineering habits - Git, code review, CI/CD (GitHub Actions), writing clear docs, Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CDK or SAM) **Role details** • Engagement - Full-time consultant, 3-month initial contract, renewable on performance • Compensation - ₹1,00,000/month fixed • Location - Remote · India • Hours - Full-time, with overlap during Indian business hours; on-call for integration incidents shared with the team • Equipment - Your own laptop; AWS, Google Cloud and Meta developer access provided • IP and confidentiality - All code and work product belong to iris / Affinity Answers; NDA required

Millions of people rely on digital maps every day to navigate, to discover, to find their way. But maps are only as accurate as the data behind them, and data is only as trustworthy as the people who verify it. Your knowledge of India's geography, local landmarks, and how people actually navigate your region is something no algorithm can fully replicate. That local intelligence is what makes maps genuinely useful.

A Day in the Life of an Online Data Analyst

In this role, you will conduct structured quality audits on spatial and mapping datasets. Your role is to verify, evaluate, and validate complex geographic and business information using advanced mapping tools and detailed reference materials.

• Conduct structured quality audits on spatial datasets using mapping platforms, search directories, and GIS-standard evaluation tools

• Evaluate and cross-reference complex business, geographic, and cultural data entries against multiple authoritative sources

• Perform root-cause analysis when spatial data points conflict across sources, documenting the discrepancy with precise reasoning

• Apply detailed evaluation frameworks with consistency and rigor across dozens of geographic, business, and cultural data variations
